enchantments.tooltip: +15 Enhancement Bonus: +15 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.

Legendary Virulent Poison: This item carries a potent poison that is delivered with your attacks. On any strike, the Poison has a chance to be applied, dealing 5d6 Constitution damage if your enemy fails a DC100 Fortitude saving throw.
Wounding 3: This weapon saps the health from your enemies, dealing 3 Constitution damage on each hit.
Critical Wounding 3: This deadly weapon saps the health from your enemies, dealing 3 Constitution damage on each critical hit.

Proof Against Poison +11: This item grants its wearer immunity to natural poisons. This item also grants a +11 Enhancement bonus to saving throws against magical poisons, and the wearer does not fail saving throws against them on a roll of a natural 1 (this renders the wearer immune to magical poisons with a DC of less than 12 + their Fortitude save).
